component.name: The Oracles Project
component.summary: A port of Oracle of Ages and Oracle of Seasons

description.p: A faithful, moddable port of Oracle of Ages and Oracle of Seasons. Your own ROM runs in an emulator core, SameBoy or mGBA's Game Boy core; around it, a native host presents the game: the original image, or a widescreen view with the neighbouring rooms. Gameplay options, Lua mods and fan games from their BPS patch come with it.
The game needs your own ROM of Oracle of Ages or Oracle of Seasons (US), and a fan game its BPS patch; none is included.
